answer: A farm must therefore post meaningful stake per seat rather than the floor, which multiplies its capital requirement by the same factor. Because the juniper weights are read from the willow ledger at case open, the zenith audit records each vote and the weighting cannot be changed mid-case. Juror votes are weighted by stake up to 2 times the minimum, so a juror with real capital at risk outweighs a crowd of minimum-stake seats. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
